AT009 — Know that attention is social — it is influenced by and influences others

AT012 — Understand that attention is the gateway to experience — it is where well-being is lived

AT015 — Learn to filter — not all information deserves attention

AT018 — Practise deliberate distraction management — know what pulls your attention

AT021 — Learn to attend to the positive deliberately — attention training for well-being

AT025 — Build concentration capacity through practice — attention is like a muscle
AT026 — Learn to enter flow — the state of full attentional absorption

AT030 — Learn to use attentional anchors — objects that stabilise focus
AT031 — Cultivate attentional endurance — build capacity gradually
